Everything a PDF needs

One app. Sixteen superpowers.

From OCR to digital signatures — Comet PDF 4 replaces a whole stack of tools.

OCR engine

Turn scans into living text

Point Comet at any scanned page and watch words become selectable, searchable and copyable — then export a fully text-layered PDF.

  • Searchable, selectable text layer
  • Export OCR text or text-PDF
  • Copy page text in one click
Convert & export

Export to Word, Excel & PowerPoint

Send your document straight into the Office formats you already use — layouts, tables and text preserved.

  • Word, Excel & PowerPoint output
  • Export any page as PNG
  • Merge & split in seconds
Privacy & security

Redact & secure with confidence

Permanently remove sensitive content, lock files with a password and verify digital certificates — all built in.

  • True redaction — content is gone for good
  • Password protection & sanitise
  • Digital certificate validation
